newsitem.title: CANADA: Telepanel Systems launches European arm.
newsitem.headline: Telepanel Systems launches European arm.

text.p: Maker of electronic shelf price panels Telepanel Systems Inc said it formed Telepanel Europe SA, aided by a US$4 million investment from a group of investors led by Paris-based Apax Partners & Cie.
The companies will fund Telepanel Europe with up to US$6 million and will place an initial order for 20 wireless electronic shelf pricing systems in anticipation of demand, Telepanel said.
The venture will also support International Business Machines Corp, which has the majority of the European retail automation market, it said.
Telepanel will be a 44 percent partner in the European venture. Apax is an investment organization that finances businesses.
